exact_dedup.rule: Records with byte-identical W4CE1 canonical_event_id are automatically one provisional real-world event group, regardless of venue.
exact_dedup.same_venue_aliases: Already-canonicalized same-venue aliases remain one record for independent-N purposes.
exact_dedup.cross_venue_exact_match: Auto-collapse only when resolved_family, event_reference_date and normalized_subject_key are also identical; any impossible signature disagreement under the same W4CE1 id is a hard collision and fails the gate.

candidate_duplicate_queue.purpose: Catch likely same real-world occurrences whose venue reference dates or wording differ, without using official truth yet and without auto-merging them.
candidate_duplicate_queue.macro_rule: Different exact groups, different venues, same resolved_family, exact normalized_subject_key, absolute reference-date distance <= 3 calendar days.
candidate_duplicate_queue.nonmacro_exact_subject_rule: Different exact groups, different venues, same resolved_family, exact normalized_subject_key, absolute reference-date distance <= 14 calendar days.
candidate_duplicate_queue.nonmacro_fuzzy_rule: Different exact groups, different venues, same resolved_family, reference-date distance <= 14 calendar days, normalized-subject token Jaccard >= 0.80, and both subjects contain at least 2 tokens.
candidate_duplicate_queue.fuzzy_tokenization: Split normalized_subject_key on underscores; discard empty tokens only. No embedding, LLM, edit-distance or outcome information is allowed.
candidate_duplicate_queue.resolution: Every candidate edge remains UNRESOLVED_PRE_OFFICIAL_TRUTH. The subsequent official-event-truth stage may confirm merge, confirm distinct, or leave unresolved with evidence.

bounds.exact_dedup_n: Number of exact W4CE1 groups after automatic exact matching.
bounds.candidate_merge_lower_bound_n: Number of connected components if every preregistered candidate duplicate edge were ultimately confirmed as same occurrence. This is a conservative lower bound, not a final N.
bounds.pretruth_upper_bound_n: exact_dedup_n; treats every non-exact candidate as distinct.
bounds.final_unique_n: Forbidden until official-event-truth adjudicates candidate links.
